facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 942
facts.text: The Language setting is separate from Foundry's own language on purpose.
keywords: Separate from Foundry's own language on purpose

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 942
facts.text: The Language setting takes effect after a reload.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 942
facts.text: The glossary stays English in both languages.
keywords: The glossary stays English in both

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 943
facts.text: Theme is Stained Glass (the current look) or Monokuma Legacy.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 943
facts.text: Monokuma Legacy has a pixel font switch.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 943
facts.text: Under Stained Glass a new phase or time of day turns the glass.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 943
facts.text: The new color arrives from the middle within about 1.2 seconds.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 943
facts.text: The seams flash once.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 943
facts.text: Where the panels must move, the panes slide whole to their new places with their texture.
keywords: the panes slide whole to their new places with their texture

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 943
facts.text: With reduced motion the glass takes its new state at once.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 944
facts.text: Interface scale runs from 80% to 140%.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 944
facts.text: Under Stained Glass the settings include glass pulse, state name behind the clock and glass blurs the map.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 944
facts.text: Glass blurs the map is the first thing to turn off if the screen stutters.
keywords: the first thing to turn off if the screen stutters

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 945
facts.text: Reduced motion and high contrast are under both themes.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 945
facts.text: Each also follows your operating system when it asks for them.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 947
facts.text: If the screen stutters, in the settings window and one at a time: turn glass blurs the map off first, then glass pulse and state name behind the clock, then turn reduced motion on, and last try the theme Monokuma Legacy.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 947
facts.text: Each change affects only your own screen.
keywords: Each changes only your own screen

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 947
facts.text: If the GM asks how fast your screen runs, stand still, open the console (F12), type await game.drpg.fps({ toChat: false }).

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 947
facts.text: Copy what the command prints after about twenty seconds.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 947
facts.text: While it measures, the glass and the map's effects switch off for a second at most each and come back by themselves.
keywords: for a second at most each

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 947
facts.text: At the end of the measuring the map stands still for a second.
keywords: the map stands still for a second

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 948
facts.text: The settings include Messenger sounds, and the Sound and Music volumes.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 949
facts.text: Voice settings apply while you are in voice: your microphone and sound output, the microphone's mode and the push-to-talk key.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 949
facts.text: The microphone's mode is Always on or Push to talk.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 949
facts.text: If no microphone is listed, allow the browser to use it and open the window again.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: Every roll you make is seen by you and the GMs alone.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: A GM sees your dice fall only while that GM's Monokuma stands in your room.
keywords: only while that GM's Monokuma stands in your room

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: The result reaches the GMs either way.
keywords: the result reaches the GMs either way

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: Nobody sees anyone else's dice, with two exceptions.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: A roll in a murder's fight is shown to the people in it.
keywords: A roll in a murder's fight is shown to the people in it

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: The fight's roll shows its dice, what it came to and which action it was.
keywords: its dice, what it came to and which action it was

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: The fight's roll is shown from the moment the incident begins to its end.
keywords: from the moment the incident begins to its end

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: A trap's builder is not among the people who see a murder's fight roll.
keywords: A trap's builder is not among them

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: A trap's builder sees none of its dice and none of its cards.
keywords: none of its dice and none of its cards

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: A trap's builder does not see the card of the action that ends it either.
keywords: the card of the action that ends it included

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: What the opening roll came to is told to the roller's side alone.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: The roller's side is the killers of a direct murder or a trap's victim.
keywords: the killers of a direct murder, a trap's victim

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: The clean-up stays the roller's own.
keywords: the clean-up stays the roller's own

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: A Monocub's rolls, Confusion included, are seen by everyone in their room.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: The one roll everybody reads is a public roll the GM throws.

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: The public roll the GM throws is not yet checked at a table.
keywords: not yet checked at a table

facts.place: 16. Interface tips, line 951
facts.text: Public rolls the GM throws include a vote's tie and Monokuma's lottery.
